display.purpose: Big headings, section titles, and brand banners.

body.purpose: General readable paragraphs, lists, and form data.

shadows.name: hover-glow
shadows.purpose: Subtle glow response on hover of interactive primary buttons.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Standard deceleration curve for state transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Standard action button for form submissions and primary CTAs.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0EA5E9; color: #05070F; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; padding: 12px 32px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), transform 0.1s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #38BDF8; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.15); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary action button for fallbacks and navigation links.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #0B0E17; color: #F8FAFC; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.05em; padding: 12px 32px; border: 1px solid #475569; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #121824; border-color: #F8FAFC; }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: Flat card outline used for feature summaries and text containers.
components.html:
WhatsApp CRM

Extract structured data directly from customer chats automatically.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #0B0E17; border: 1px solid #1E293B; border-radius: 6px; padding: 24px; transition: background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-card:hover { background: #121824; border-color: #38BDF8; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; color: #F8FAFC; margin: 0 0 8px 0; } .ds-card-desc { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; color: #CBD5E1; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Text input field used in interactive contact forms.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #0B0E17; color: #F8FAFC; border: 1px solid #1E293B; border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #0EA5E9; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.2); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #64748B; }

narrative.overview: "The Technical Ledger" is a design system that presents complex automation capabilities with the extreme clarity of an engineering document or accounting ledger. The interface is optimized for decision-makers and operations managers, avoiding distracting decorations, curved gradients, or floating layers. Instead, it relies on high information density, precise alignment, thin structural dividers, and generous, purposeful whitespace.
keyCharacteristics: Technical Rigor: Strict 1px dividers separate content blocks rather than card margins or floating offsets.
Typographic Contrast: Large, geometric Outfit headlines paired with clean, readable Inter body copy.
Information Density: Clean tables, node connection charts, and data rows present complexity with pride.

rules.name: The Accent Rarity Rule
rules.body: The vivid sky-blue color (#0EA5E9) must represent less than 5% of any page's visible area. It is reserved exclusively for primary actions, focus indicators, and data-flow pipelines.

rules.name: The Flat-Grid Rule
rules.body: All panels and cards rest on the same visual plane. Do not use drop-shadows to separate surfaces at rest.

dos: Do keep cards flat and separate them using thin 1px borders instead of floating shadows.
Do use strict uppercase labels with 0.05em letter-spacing for all small labels and headers.
Do ensure line lengths for paragraphs do not exceed 75ch for readability.
donts: Don't use gradients or multi-colored backgrounds inside layout sections.
Don't mix circular rounded buttons (pill style) with rectangular inputs; keep all elements at a uniform 6px radius.
Don't add arbitrary shadows to suggest elevation hierarchies.
